{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droidome''' was a type of virtual reality game where a user could have the opportunity of experiencing the sensation of being a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The user would have the temporary appearance and persona of a droid, with the choices ranging from [[Security droid/Legends|security]], construction, [[Translator droid/Legends|translator]] and engineer droid.<ref name="CNII">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

Most droids found the attraction obscene and unrealistic. They believed that the game did not present an accurate picture of the hardships a real droid goes through, such as casual disposal or [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismemberment]].<ref name="CNII" />
